blocks.title: Introduction
blocks.content:

which has a totally geodesic boundary. By a hyperbolic manifold, we mean a

boundary of such a 3-manifold becomes a hyperbolic surface.

blocks.title: Thurston [3]
blocks.content: Let M 3 be a non-singular hyperbolic 3- manifold, possibly with boundary dM 2, obtained by gluing together the faces of polyhedra in H 3 with some vertices at infinity. Then M 3 is complete if and only if the similarity structure on each link of an ideal vertex is actually a Euclidean structure.
